definitions.explanation: The edge of a town or entertainment district, away from the busy centre, with cheap, run-down bars and shops. Usually used as a modifier with の, and often with a note of nostalgia.

examples.japanese: {場末|ばすえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{酒場|さかば}→酒場：00356_sakaba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: To drink at a seedy bar on the edge of town.

examples.japanese: {場末|ばすえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画館|えいがかん}→映画館：01024_eigakan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched an old film at a shabby little cinema on the outskirts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧ころ、{場末|ばすえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スナック→スナック：27527_sunakku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歌|うた}って→歌う：00684_utau⟧⟦{暮|く}らしていた→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: When he was young, he made a living singing in run-down bars in the back streets.

notes:
Literally the far end (⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧) of a place (⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {場末|ばすえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{酒場|さかば}→酒場：00356_sakaba⟧ / ⟦バー→バー：07060_baa⟧ / ⟦スナック→スナック：27527_sunakku⟧: a seedy bar
- {場末|ばすえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画館|えいがかん}→映画館：01024_eigakan⟧: a run-down cinema
- {場末|ばすえ}{感|かん}: a shabby, down-at-heel feel (informal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{繁華街|はんかがい}→繁華街：09392_hankagai⟧: a busy shopping and entertainment district; the lively heart of town, where {場末|ばすえ} is its fringe
- ⟦{裏通|うらどお}り→裏通り：09383_uradoori⟧: a back street; just a side street, without the shabbiness
